compute_topk_correct: compute the number of correct predictions for each top-k value given PyTorch prediction and label tensors
compute_topk_errors: compute the top-k error percentage for each k value given predictions and labels
compute_topk_accuracies: compute the top-k accuracy percentage for each k value given predictions and labels
test_topks_correct: test the topks_correct function with sample PyTorch tensors for predictions and labels
refactor_topk_accuracies: refactor the topk_accuracies function to support additional accuracy metrics beyond top-k
